name: Warrior of Tyr generates Energy from any periodic damage tick (#5163, #4432)
contract: Warrior of Tyr 301253's Description reads "Periodic damage dealt now generates $524987s1 Energy" (10).
NativePowerGainRules has {ClassId 19, FirstSpellId 0, LastSpellId 0, PowerType 3, InternalAmount 10,
MatchesNativePowerRule treats it as matching any spell (AscensionCompat.cpp's MatchesNativePowerRule),
not only Condemn or Blade of Faith specifically. Condemn 567541 (EffectApplyAuraName[0] =
SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, tick every 3000 ms) is used here as a real periodic-damage source: one tick
against a hostile target with 301253 known must add 10 to power type 3.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: Condemn itself costs 30 Energy to cast (Spell.dbc PowerType 3, ManaCost 30)
Baseline taken after Condemn's own cast cost is paid, so only the periodic tick can raise Energy
Let one 3 sec periodic tick land
DISCRIMINATING: one periodic damage tick generates 10 Energy
